# MedPro Group

> MedPro Group is a leading provider of medical malpractice insurance and risk management solutions for healthcare professionals, backed by Berkshire Hathaway since 1899.

MedPro Group specializes in comprehensive malpractice insurance coverage for physicians, dentists, and other healthcare providers. The company offers integrated services including quote requests, policy management, claims defense, risk management resources, and continuing education to support healthcare professionals in protecting their practices.
